title: Self-Trapping Bounds for Continuous-Time Nonlinear Quantum Walks on Path and Cycle Graphs
summary: We explore a continuous-time quantum walk starting at a single vertex on the discrete path and cycle with a cubic nonlinearity. Such nonlinearities arise in Bose-Einstein condensates described by the Gross-Pitaevskii equation or by nonlinear optical waveguide arrays. When the nonlinearity is sufficiently strong, the walker remains localized at its initial vertex, a phenomenon known as self-trapping.
